name: Marshall 2021
ignition_source: Juliano et al. 2023, Geophysical Research Letters 50, e2022GL101557 (CC BY): 'two reported initial ignition points, occurring at 18:08 and 19:00 UTC'; the first time is used (protocol A18)

ignition.source: derived, not surveyed: 200 m due south of the OpenStreetMap position of the Marshall Mesa Trailhead (way 52431306, ODbL), from the Boulder County Sheriff's Office release of 8 Jun 2023 placing the second fire 'just south of the Marshall Mesa Trailhead'; uncertainty about 200 m; one ignition lit at the first fire's time (data/marshall_2021/ignition/SOURCE.md, protocol A18)

box_note: the final perimeter's bounding box plus about 5 km

landfire.units_source: data/marshall_2021/landfire/VERSION.md: LF 2020 (LF 2.2.0) fuels; CC %, CH m x 10, CBH m x 10, CBD kg/m3 x 100

live_moisture_note: Scott and Burgan 2005 live scenario L1 (fully cured herbaceous 30 %, woody 60 %): an assumption for dormant winter grass and shrubs after a dry autumn, not a measurement. Protocol amendment A5.

buildings.note: USGS CC0 release (doi 10.5066/P1QX6UXD): the pre-fire building points, so embers and houses act as in Camp. Houses are NOT scored in the A18 reading; the building output is stored for a later amendment.

perimeters.name: NASA FEDS
perimeters.note: protocol A19: FEDS outlines timed at the last VIIRS pass in their half-day (21:05Z 30 Dec = 2.95 h; 09:24Z 31 Dec = 15.27 h, 1.27 h after the window, scored only by scripts/rescore.py against the model's end state)
